volume.tooltip: Speaker level (−∞…0 dB). 0 dB is unity. Default −3 dB. Old patches that stored 0…1 linear Volume are converted on load. Type a dB value (or −inf).

pan.tooltip: Stereo balance after Mono is summed in. 0 = unchanged (Mono to both). −1 = left only. +1 = right only.

tuning.tooltip: A4 reference Hz. MIDI 69 maps to this frequency when converting Pitch→Hz.

octave.tooltip: Add octaves to the zero-based pitch before Hz conversion.

semitones.tooltip: Add semitones to the zero-based pitch before Hz conversion.

cents.tooltip: Add cents / 100 to the zero-based pitch before Hz conversion.

multiply.tooltip: Hz-domain multiply after Pitch→Hz. Applies to ƒ and inc, not the ♯/♭ thru.

add.tooltip: Hz-domain offset after Multiply. Applies to ƒ and inc, not the ♯/♭ thru.

mode.tooltip: Lin = clamp Env to 0…1. Exp = classic VCA CV law (quiet lows, unity at 1) for Amplitude params.

octave.tooltip: Transpose quantized pitch and ƒ by whole octaves. Also shifts Scale out (0 = C3).

semitones.tooltip: Transpose quantized pitch and ƒ by integer semitones.

model.tooltip: ModelA = original one-pole attack/release (default). ModelB = vactrol-style: release slows as it darkens (fast drop, long tail) and lengthens after long/bright light.

recalculateOnTrigger.tooltip: On = latch Model/Attack/Release/Curve/Sensitivity on rising Retrigger. Off = knobs always live. Retrigger never resets the level; unconnected Retrigger = live.

attack.tooltip: Rise time constant toward a brighter Light target. 0 = instant.

release.tooltip: Fall time constant toward a dimmer Light target (photoconductive lag).

curve.tooltip: Gamma after the one-pole. 1 = linear; >1 digs in; <1 lifts the tail.

sensitivity.tooltip: Gain on Light before the detector (unipolar clip).

inLow.tooltip: Input value that maps to Out Low. Default −1 (bipolar). Slider domain −10…+10.

inHigh.tooltip: Input value that maps to Out High. Default +1 (bipolar). Slider domain −10…+10.

outLow.tooltip: Output at In Low. Default 0. Slider domain −10…+10.

outHigh.tooltip: Output at In High. Default +1. Slider domain −10…+10.

source.tooltip: Sine. Dithered Sine = Robin Schmidt cycle-length dither. Dithered Trisaw = Robin Schmidt's dithering oscillator, trisaw form (Morph 0.5 triangle, 0 / 1 saws). PolyBLEP Trisaw = antialiased (PolyBLAMP) triangle, same Morph (0.5 triangle, 0 / 1 saws). Soft Square = soundemote.dev SquareToSine. Soft Tri = soundemote.dev Ellipsoid Sym, triangle (Morph 0) to sine (Morph 1). Soft Square and Soft Tri round off automatically at high pitches so they never alias.

frequency.tooltip: Default slider 0…20 kHz. Pitch MOD can run down through 0. Thru-zero: enable Bipolar on Frequency (domain-add MOD). Domain min/max are slider guides. Wired ƒ replaces this knob.

morph.tooltip: Shape per source. Sine: none. Dithered Sine: dither amount (0 = plain sine). Trisaw: peak position (0.5 = triangle, edges = saw). Soft Square: 0 = sine, 0.5 = soft square, 1 = near-hard square. Soft Tri: 0 = sharp triangle, 1 = rounded.

pitchMod.tooltip: Slider 0..4800 cents (4 octaves), 300 c at the middle for fine vibrato-to-noise control. 1σ exponential pitch wobble in cents around the effective frequency. 0 = none.

ampMod.tooltip: Level-preserving full-band noise AM. 1 = full ring mod (no carrier).

color.tooltip: Noise for audio, Pitch Mod and Amp Mod. White = flat (uniform) distribution, Gaussian = normal, Average = Gaussian with 2-sample averaged Pitch Mod noise (smoother, null at Nyquist). Pink / Brown spectral colors. All unit std, so Pitch Mod cents stay true.

seed.tooltip: Master seed. Reset jack reseeds every generator from this value.

amplitude.tooltip: Scale and invert. 0 = mute, +1 = unity, −1 = invert. Bipolar rational is finer around 0.

model.tooltip: ModelA = original one-pole attack/release (default). ModelB = vactrol-style: release slows as it darkens (fast drop, long tail) and lengthens after long/bright light.

recalculateOnTrigger.tooltip: On = latch Model/Attack/Release/Curve/Sensitivity on rising Retrigger. Off = knobs always live. Retrigger never resets the level; unconnected Retrigger = live.

attack.tooltip: Rise time constant toward a brighter Light target. 0 = instant.

release.tooltip: Fall time constant toward a dimmer Light target (photoconductive lag).

curve.tooltip: Gamma after the one-pole. 1 = linear; >1 digs in; <1 lifts the tail.

sensitivity.tooltip: Gain on Light before the detector (unipolar clip).

inLow.tooltip: Input value that maps to Out Low. Default −1 (bipolar). Slider domain −10…+10.

inHigh.tooltip: Input value that maps to Out High. Default +1 (bipolar). Slider domain −10…+10.

outLow.tooltip: Output at In Low. Default 0. Slider domain −10…+10.

outHigh.tooltip: Output at In High. Default +1. Slider domain −10…+10.

speed.tooltip: Steps per second. 44100 at 44.1 kHz = one step per sample; above the sample rate steps are skipped. 0 freezes.

interpolation.tooltip: Hold = steps. Linear = ramp. 1-Pole / 2-Pole = lowpass chasing each step, cutoff Speed/2. Cosine = S-curve. Smoothstep = polynomial S-curve, a touch steeper in the middle. Cubic = Catmull-Rom through the steps. B-Spline = smooth, rounds the peaks. Quintic B-Spline = 6-point, even smoother, never overshoots. Gaussian = soft blur over ~16 steps, smoothest. Quadratic In = t², starts slow. Quadratic Out = 1-(1-t)², ends slow.

start.tooltip: Where in the 2,097,152-step period playback starts and Reset returns to (0 = first step, e.g. the leading 3 of pi; 1 = the last step).

loop.tooltip: At the end of the period: Wrap jumps back to step 0; Ping-Pong plays backwards, then forwards again.

quantize.tooltip: On snaps the smoothed output to the nearest of 10 levels (smoothing still sets when it changes).

seed.tooltip: Seed for Random Digits, White, Gaussian, Random Walk and Logistic Map (and the Fibonacci start). The stored constants ignore it.

amplitude.tooltip: Output gain on Bipolar and Unipolar, applied per sample (Trigger and Index are not scaled).

interpolation.tooltip: Delay-line fractional read. Linear (default). Hidden — enable from the parameter visibility menu.

pingPong.tooltip: PingPong Off = parallel stereo delay. Left Right = L→R bounce. Left Middle Right = taps at T / 2T / 3T panned L, center, R.

timeNumerator.tooltip: Numerator of Numer/Denom × whole note. Numer=0 → no delay. Examples: 1/4, 1/8, 1/16, 1/32.

timeDenominator.tooltip: Denominator of Numer/Denom × whole note. At Numer=1: Denom 4=¼, 8=⅛, 16=1/16, 32=1/32.

timingMode.tooltip: Normal = Numer/Denom as written. Dotted = 1.5×. Triplet = 2/3×.

offset.tooltip: Static trim (ms) of the tempo-base delay on both taps: delay = tempoBase + Offset + LFO_Amp×lfo. Not LFO depth — that is LFO Amp. Negative shortens, positive lengthens. Sample-accurate — pitches when swept or MOD’d.

lfoStyle.tooltip: Shape of the built-in delay-time modulator. Parabol / Random Walk / FBM.

lfoRate.tooltip: LFO speed in Hz (0…20). Speed only — depth is LFO Amp (ms). Gold LFO L/R outs move whenever Rate > 0, even if Amp is 0.

lfoAmp.tooltip: How far the LFO moves delay time (ms) around (tempoBase + Offset). Default 25 ms is audible wow; 0 = tempoBase+Offset only (Rate still drives gold LFO outs). Unlike Delay Mod (fraction of delay time), this depth is absolute milliseconds.

lfoVariation.tooltip: Detunes L vs R LFO rates so the two delays don’t lock together.

lpfFrequency.tooltip: Passive one-pole lowpass in the feedback loop (darkens repeats). 0 Hz holds (closed); DSP caps at Nyquist. Slider min/max are guides only.

hpfFrequency.tooltip: Passive one-pole highpass in the feedback loop (thins mud / DC). Slider min/max are guides only; DSP caps at Nyquist.

feedback.tooltip: Feedback into the saturated tape loop. Saturate soft-clips. >1 can self-oscillate.

saturate.tooltip: Soft clip in the feedback path (tape grunge). Lower = harder saturation; higher = cleaner.

mix.tooltip: Dry/wet mix on Mix L / Mix R.

seed.tooltip: LFO random (walk / FBM) seed. Same Seed = same modulation.

interpolate.tooltip: Glide curve from the previous hold to the new sample. Only active when Smoothing > 0. Applies to Ext and internal Left/Right, internal Sample Freq or external Clock.

smoothing.tooltip: Glide time as a factor of the clock period (1/Sample Freq, or the last Clock interval). 0 = classic hold (instant step at the latch), 1 = glide lasts one period, >1 = never quite arrives before the next latch. Not clamped above.

phaseOffset.tooltip: Delays the Right lane's latch by this fraction of the clock period (0 and 1 = with Left, 0.5 = halfway). Ext and Left always latch on the clock.

polarity.tooltip: Bipolar = −1…1 (raw hold / noise). Unipolar = 0…1 on audio outs for MOD into unipolar params (Sweep, Frequency, etc.) without a B2U. Face/waterfall reads Left Raw / Right Raw (bipolar full height; ignores Polarity), same spirit as Amplitude.

amplitude.tooltip: Scale Ext Out (and L/R audio). Face Left Raw / Right Raw always show full hold. 0 = mute, 1 = full. Use instead of an external attenuverter for MOD depth.

seed.tooltip: Internal noise seed (Left/Right lanes). Same Seed = same held values.

mode.tooltip: Always 2-pole. Isolate: Cut/Boost down dips the band; up keeps the peak at 0 dB and drops everything else.

frequency.tooltip: Cutoff / center in Hz. When ƒ is wired, that Hz is absolute. Unwired uses this knob (Hz). 0 allowed (frozen).

q.tooltip: Resonance / bandwidth. ~0.707 is Butterworth-like for Lowpass/Highpass. High Q pings.

gain.tooltip: Peak / shelves: classic dB. Isolate: down = cut the band, up = keep the peak and cut the rest. Ignored on Bypass, Lowpass, Highpass.

mode.tooltip: Real-pole stacks. Bypass = dry. LP / HP use LPF / HPF. BP is HP→LP in series (no cutoff swap — HPF above LPF collapses the band).

slope.tooltip: Cascaded real 1-poles. 6 dB = one pole; 24 dB = four. No resonance.

stagger.tooltip: Pole spread ratio k. 1 = same freq; ~1.5 gentle spread; above ~2.2 a stair-step. No effect at 6 dB.

lowFrequency.tooltip: Highpass cutoff (HP and BP). In BP, raising this past LPF collapses the passband (series HP→LP).

highFrequency.tooltip: Lowpass cutoff (LP and BP). In BP, lowering this past HPF collapses the passband (series HP→LP).

sweep.tooltip: Shift used cutoffs in semitones. BP keeps the HPF/LPF interval (ratio) constant.

gainCompensation.tooltip: On = scale poles so the labeled cutoff is −3 dB. Off = every pole sits on the staggered freqs. No effect at 6 dB.
